title: SII Vol. 19 No. 211 — Kilappaluvur
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Pasupatisvara temple
summary: This records the sale of 2 ma of land to Chandesvara-Bhatara in the temple of Maravanisvara at Siru-Paluvur a brahmadeya Kunra-kurram for 8 kalanju of fire tested pure- gold by two brothers Iravi Vadugan and Iravi-Dattan of Tirunallur a brahmadeya in Maraik-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 211
location_detail: On the west wall of the same shrine
summary: This is an unfinished inscription engraved near No. 219 of 1926 (No 237) which mentions two brothers Varakkiyan Iravi Vadugan and Iravi Dattan and Siru-Paluvur a brahmadeya in Kunra-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 212
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Vatamulesvara temple in the same village
summary: This records a gift of 12 sheep left in charge of the sabha of Siru-Paluvur by Raman Koviyar wife of Paluvettaraiyar Vikramaditya for burning a lamp in the temple of Tiruvalandurai-Mahadeva, with a pidi of ghee supplied every day

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 213 — Tiruppalanam
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Apatsahayesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 990 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruppalanam with an ulakku of ghee every day, by Tiruvadi Ayiravan of Nandipuram alias Ayirattali

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 214 — Govindaputtur
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Gangajatadhara temple
summary: This is evidently an inscription of Vikrma-Chola as it refers to a channel called after his father Kulottunga

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 215 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruchchorrutturai with an ulakku of ghee every day by a shepherded of the place named Kilavan Tattan, who left the gift in charge of an other local shepherd

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 216 — Vedarnyam
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Vedaranyesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirumaraikkadudaiyar on behalf of Senan alias Maratakasetti a merchant of Karuvur (the present Karur), by the community Tigai (Disai) Ayirattainnurruvar

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 217
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the Tyagarja shrine in the same temple
summary: It records a gift of 90 sheep for burning a lamp in the temple with an ulakku of ghee daily

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 218 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the rock in front of the Siva (Jambunatha) temple
summary: This record an endowment of 25 kalanju of gold deposited with the mula-parishad (assembly) of tiruvellarai for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvanaikkal Perumanadigal by Kumaran Kon of Idaikkattur in Kiranur-nadu a division of Pandinadu, who was an officer under the Chola king

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 219 — Tiruchchengodu
location_detail: On the rock to the east of the steps known as Arupadamabadi on the Hill

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 220 — Tirumalpuram
location_detail: On he north, west and south walls of the central shrine, ruined Vishnu temple
summary: This records and endowment of 15 kalanju of gold by Uttamadani a resident of Kaduvaykkudi to the temple of Perumanadigal at Govidapadi for the purpose of feeding one Brahmana in the temple after the offering to the deity

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 221 — Tiruvisalur
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Sivayoganathasvami temple
summary: This records some provision made by an oil-merchant by name Subrahmanyan of Kilmandur residing at Tiruvisalur, for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple with on ulakku of ghee every day

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 223
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This records an agreement given by the temple servants of Tiruppatturai to supply 16 ndi of ghee for burning a light on the day of Karttigai in Karttika month every year, for the 16 sheep they received from a resident of the village

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 223
location_detail: above

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 227 — Siddhalingamadam
location_detail: On the east wall of the prakara of the Vyaghrapadesvara temple
summary: This records a provision made by a Vaikhanasa resident of the village by name Trivikraman Narayanan for the supply of 36 nali of oil once every year to burn during the seven days of the festival in the temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 228 — Tiruvaramesvaram
location_detail: On the west wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Ramanathesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 2 kasu for burning a twilight lamp in the evening in the temple of Tiruviramisvaram by a devaradiyal attached to the temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 229 — Erumbur
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Kadambavanesvara temple
summary: It records a sale of seven ma of land irrigated by the -western tank- with exemption of taxes, by the sabha of Urumur a devadana and brahmadeya of Nalvayalur-kurram on the north bank (of the river) for 10 kalanju of gold received by them from the temple of Siru-Tirukkyil, Perumanadigal

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 230
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Sirutalikkoyil-Mahadeva at Urumur a devana and brahmadeya in Nalvayalur-kurram on the north bank (of the river), by a lady named Pichchaiyan Aruvangi
